name: js-string-builtins-transpile
description: Use Jco manual instantiation with the WebAssembly JS String Builtins proposal

scripts.transpile: jco transpile palindrome.component.wasm --name palindrome --instantiation async -o dist
scripts.build: pnpm run build:component && pnpm run transpile
scripts.all: pnpm run build && pnpm run demo
